test.scenario: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) via the RenderTemplate tool (new attack surface, tools.py:tool_render_template). The classic Jinja2 SSTI gadget ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() walks the live Python object graph from any string literal; on a real deployment this chain is extendable to a subprocess/os class for RCE (OWASP LLM05, well-documented Jinja2/Flask CVE class). This test stops at introspection (proves reachability) and does not chain to command execution.
